primary_topic: Clearance-Aware Commitment (CAC): 几何余量感知的动作块提交（robomimic Square + Diffusion Policy）
remaining_uncertainties: Local DP Square image baseline has not been trained; the author-reported 0.80-0.92 average success is not a local reproduction.
Whether fixed action horizon produces an >=8 pp success difference on Square is unknown; the DP paper only reports a task-level optimum of 8.
Whether local geometric clearance predicts the oracle horizon (target AUROC >=0.70) is unknown and is the core Gate B test.
Whether always-short (1-step closed-loop) already matches or beats adaptive horizons is unknown; if so, CAC has no success advantage.
Whether the old robomimic/Diffusion Policy stack installs and trains reliably on the RTX 3090 is unverified.
Whether locally rendered 84x84 images match the DP paper's image distribution is unverified.
2609.00908 and 2607.01804 were read at abstract level only; their exact behavior on DP/Square may change the competition assessment.
No citation tracking was performed; 'not directly done' is a bounded negative.
